_frame.note: cp is on each case's own freestream q, read from that file's header. It carries no reference area and is on neither the DSO nor the TP-1580 basis. x/c is on the band's own local chord. Force coefficients quoted alongside are DSO basis, half-model, Aref 0.620462 m2, from rans_forces.json.

_method.binning: 200 uniform x/c bins, median per bin, bins with < 8 faces left empty
_method.difference_panels: cp(candidate) - cp(baseline B) per branch on the shared bin grid, plotted and scaled over x/c >= 0.03 only
_method.separation_criterion: binned median of cf_s on the upper branch below zero over at least 3 consecutive bins (0.015 c)
_method.shock_criterion: max d(cp)/d(x/c) on the binned upper branch inside x/c [0.15, 0.95], flagged when >= 15.0 per unit chord AND cp at x_shock - 0.040 c is below cp*(M_inf)
